forensic_summary.intervention: Erik Norris led a multi-threaded investigation, redesigning the pinch roller assembly (solid motor mounts, extended gears), implementing new inner disc guides to prevent scratching, and revising cosmetic inspection standards to unblock production.
forensic_summary.result: Identification of root causes (e.g., abrasive dust, missing e-clips, 'potato chipped' carousels) and release of corrective tooling/parts to stabilize the fleet.
forensic_summary.trigger: High field failure rates for M700/DV700 vaults due to 'disc unreadable' errors, jammed discs, and 'line down' production stops caused by cosmetic cover defects.

forensic_metrics.financial: Saved $6/unit by fixing screw vibration; debated $4/unit for coated rollers
forensic_metrics.governance: Weekly Reliability Investigation meetings; 100% incoming RMA inspection
forensic_metrics.process: Recovered ~60% yield from rejected cover stock via revised inspection criteria
